title: Bring back earlier work
body: Your past sessions, ready when they matter.
line: Keating 4.0 remembers what you've already worked on, and brings that work back when it matters.

title: Turn it on in Learning Settings
body: A 36 MB model that stays on your machine.
line: Turn on recall in Learning Settings. On desktop, it's a thirty-six megabyte model that stays on your own machine.

title: Quoted, with its source
body: Needle keeps the offsets of every passage.
line: Before a reply, Needle finds the exact passage from your earlier work, and keeps a reference to where it came from.

title: Search by meaning
body: 35 MB on device. The browser runs it locally too.
line: On your phone, Search by meaning finds sessions by idea, not keyword. In the browser, recall runs locally as well.

title: Remembered, on the record
body: Every saved memory keeps its source.
line: And an interest you mention today can become useful context next time, with its source kept alongside. Your past work, working for you.
